title: reliab findings
description: What an external adapter writes for a command with format: findings. The file is the whole result: reliab does not consult the command's exit code once it parses. See knowledge/decisions/external-adapters.md.

mutants.description: For a mutation tool: how many mutants it tested, so a report can say tested, killed, and survived, not only list survivors.

mutantFiles.description: The mutant counts per repo-relative file.

findings.description: Empty when the tool found nothing.

test.description: What failed, and the finding's identity: the same failure must get the same test across runs so classifications carry forward. Unique within the file.

replay.description: Path of the saved seed or input that reproduces it.

mutantCounts.description: Mutants a mutation command tested, after any changed-lines filter: killed (timeouts included), survived, and notCovered (no test reaches the line). Mutants that did not build are not counted. Survived and notCovered mutants are also findings.

changedSince.description: Set when the counts cover only mutants on lines changed since this base ref.

mutantFiles.description: Mutant counts per repo-relative file, when the tool says.

diffLabel.description: For a text snapshot or capture that no longer matches: additive-only when lines were only added, values-changed when any line was removed or changed. It helps a person review; approval stays human. See knowledge/decisions/snapshot-diff-labels.md.
